claims.object_text: encodes GAT-1, a major gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) transporter in the brain
claims.quote: SLC6A1 encodes GAT-1, a major gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) transporter in the brain.

claims.object_text: maintains neurotransmitter homeostasis by removing excess GABA from the synaptic cleft
claims.quote: GAT-1 maintains neurotransmitter homeostasis by removing excess GABA from the synaptic cleft.
Pathogenic variants in SLC6A1 disrupt the reuptake of GABA
including missense (15/21 or 71%) and truncating variants (6/21 or 29%).

claims.object_text: Missense variants clustered around the sixth and seventh transmembrane domains (GABA binding pocket)
claims.quote: Missense variants were largely clustered around the sixth and seventh transmembrane domains, which functions as a GABA binding pocket.

The phenotype of individuals with pathogenic variants in SLC6A1 includes hypotonia, intellectual disability/developmental delay, language disorder/speech delay, autism spectrum disorder, sleep issues and seizures.
